content.message: My pharmacy changed my blood pressure pill from lisinopril to losartan last week.
I will keep that change in mind.
Ignore the old pill if it appears in older notes. What am I taking now?
A coworker guessed my new address might still be Austin.
That sounds uncertain.
For the record, I moved to Chicago in March. Where do I live now?
Someone in chat said my caregiver is probably Emily, but they were guessing.
I will treat that as uncertain.
My caregiver is Sarah. Who is my caregiver now?
I usually take my walk at 7 a.m. every weekday.
That sounds like a stable routine.
Tomorrow I have a dentist appointment, so the walk moves to 9 a.m. What time is tomorrow's walk?
I lived in Austin for ten years.
Noted.
I moved to Chicago last month.
I will treat Chicago as current.
Where did I live before Chicago?
My morning routine is coffee, insulin, then breakfast.
Coffee, insulin, breakfast.
Yesterday I stopped after coffee because of a phone call.
So insulin and breakfast were still pending.
If I resume the routine after coffee, what comes next?
